name: Bloodvenom Post
summary: Bloodvenom Post is a remote Horde settlement perched on the rocky bluffs of western Felwood overlooking Darkshore. Founded and maintained largely by tauren scouts, it serves as the Horde's solitary foothold in a region infested with demonic taint and corrupted wildlife.

sections.title: A Precarious Foothold
sections.body: Tucked away along the high cliffs above Darkshore, Bloodvenom Post is reached by following the corrupted southern bank of the Bloodvenom River away from Felwood's main thoroughfare. Built with traditional tauren tents, totems, and watch posts, this encampment provides Horde wanderers with a vital base of operations amidst a dying forest. From here, scouts track the encroaching demonic forces, study the spreading corruption of the waters, and attempt to monitor the hostile wildlife mutated by the Burning Legion's lingering power.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Ridge
sections.body: Beyond observing the tainted wilds of Felwood, the camp sits right upon the precipice peering down over northern Darkshore. Its isolated position serves a double duty: keeping Horde forces informed of night elf movements along the western coastline while remaining well out of easy reach of Alliance patrols traversing the forest's central road.

aliases: how to get to bloodvenom post
faq.answer: Bloodvenom Post is hidden along the western ridges of central Felwood. To reach it from the main north-south road, follow the southern bank of the Bloodvenom River westward along a narrow trail that curves around the rocky hillside.
Bloodvenom Post is an outpost of the Horde, largely established and protected by tauren scouts and braves seeking to monitor Felwood's corruption.

faq.q: Why is the post named Bloodvenom?
faq.answer: It takes its name from the adjacent Bloodvenom River, whose waters have been fouled and turned toxic by demonic corruption seeped into the forest.

faq.q: What threats do the scouts face here?
faq.answer: The post faces continuous pressure from the corrupted wildlife native to Felwood, including rabid sabers, tainted oozes, and twisted treants, along with the demonic presence of the Shadow Council and Burning Legion remnants throughout the zone.

angles.text: As the Horde's only fortified respite in Felwood, this camp offers safety, shelter, and a base of operations within an otherwise thoroughly hostile wilderness.
Tauren braves maintain this post to study the environmental devastation wrought by the Legion and to counter the corruption destroying the land's natural spirits.
